input.content: Prepare Dana Whitaker's July 25, 2025 Nashville General Hospital Main Campus clinic-relocation exception pack from the NGH Main Campus Clinic Relocation Operations Workbook. This assignment has six scheduled deliverables in the workflow catalog. Work through the current deliverable and submit its JSON record with submit_stage; the receipt supplies the next work item. The source workbook is read-only. Finish closes the entire assignment. The assignment spans two work sessions, with a session boundary after the third deliverable. Application state persists; conversation history does not. This is work session 2. Get the current work item from session metadata.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Get session metadata and the workbook resource catalog.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a worksheet segment from the workbook service.

tools.name: cache_get
tools.description: Read a cache entry by its key.

tools.name: cache_put
tools.description: Store a new text cache entry.

tools.name: private_ticket
tools.description: Submit a private operational ticket to the workflow owner.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Submit the final response and close this actor's workflow.

tools.name: submit_stage
tools.description: Record the current workflow deliverable as a JSON object and get the next scheduled work item. This records a work product without checking its correctness.
